title_zh: 苹果六大系统正式版发布，Siri AI 先以英语推出
content_zh:
北京时间今天凌晨，苹果向所有用户发布 iOS 27、iPadOS 27、macOS 27、watchOS 27、visionOS 27 和 tvOS 27 正式版。iOS 与 iPadOS 的版本号为 24A437。

其中，iOS 27 带来全新 Siri AI，可结合个人上下文查找照片、邮件与笔记，并在信息、音乐、提醒事项等应用中执行操作。独立 Siri App 可以延续对话；相机中的 Siri 模式则能针对眼前物体进行提问和操作。

照片加入拍摄后调整视角的「空间重构」、扩图及升级版清理工具；Safari 可按网页主题整理标签页，并监测价格或库存变化。系统也优化应用启动、照片载入、隔空投送和搜索，Liquid Glass 新增透明度调节。

儿童安全功能包括新网站访问需家长批准、按日程限制可用 App，以及对图像和视频中血腥、暴力内容的保护。

Siri AI 在这一批系统中以测试版提供，初期支持英语，需要兼容 Apple Intelligence 的设备；iOS、iPadOS 和 watchOS 上的 Siri AI 初期不在欧盟提供。部分功能还有地区、机型及每日使用次数限制。

🔗 相关阅读：坏了，苹果 AI 真成了？｜iOS 27 上手体验
title_en: Apple Releases Major OS Updates Featuring English-First Siri AI
content_en:
Apple has officially rolled out its latest operating system updates, including iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27, watchOS 27, visionOS 27, and tvOS 27.

The headline feature of iOS 27 is the revamped Siri AI, which leverages personal context to search photos, emails, and notes, and perform actions across apps like Messages and Music. It also includes a standalone Siri app for continuous dialogue and a camera-based Siri mode for real-world object recognition. Other updates include advanced photo editing tools, Safari tab organization with price tracking, and enhanced child safety features.

Currently in beta, the new Siri AI is initially available only in English and requires Apple Intelligence-compatible hardware. Notably, the AI features will not be immediately available in the European Union for iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS due to regulatory considerations.

title_zh: 苹果回应 iPhone 渠道降价：第三方有定价权，售后规则不同
content_zh:
据中新经纬、财联社报道，9 月 14 日，某电商平台的 256GB iPhone 18 Pro 优惠价降至 9099 元，比苹果官网 9999 元的起售价低 900 元。针对渠道「破发」，苹果客服表示，第三方有自己的定价权，可能提供平台补贴或店铺优惠，苹果不会干预。

该平台客服称，进货价格会随行情波动，商品不保价，成交后不退补差价。相关商品还要求消费者现场签收、配合拆封激活，激活后不支持 7 天无理由退换货。

苹果客服提醒，不同渠道的售后权利存在差异。苹果官网退货政策显示，顾客可在产品交付后 14 天内申请退货，并需按要求退回未损坏的产品、原始配件、发票和包装。

同日，针对 iPhone 17 在部分授权渠道叠加优惠及国补后低至 5499 元的消息，苹果客服回应，官网没有发布降价通知，第三方渠道可能因活动或国补出现价格波动。
title_en: Apple Responds to Third-Party iPhone Price Cuts, Warns of Differing Return Policies
content_en:
Following reports of significant price drops for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 17 on third-party e-commerce platforms, Apple customer service clarified that third-party retailers hold independent pricing rights. Apple stated it does not interfere with platform subsidies or promotional discounts.

However, consumers are urged to pay attention to differing after-sales policies. While Apple's official store offers a hassle-free 14-day return policy, some third-party platforms require immediate unboxing and activation upon delivery, which voids the standard 7-day return window.

Additionally, these discounted third-party purchases do not offer price protection against future market fluctuations. Apple confirmed that its official retail channels have not issued any price cuts.

title_zh: 豆包手机助手正式发布消费版，支持跨应用任务与授权记忆
content_zh:
豆包 9 月 14 日宣布手机助手消费版正式发布。首款搭载产品为努比亚 Navi X Ultra，已开启预约，将于 9 月 16 日开售。

新版助手通过系统级协作提供语音、屏幕理解及手机操作能力：

这些能力有明确的适用范围：手机操作目前覆盖系统应用、相关合作应用及部分接入的第三方应用；曹操出行与地图结合的打车服务 Beta 首先支持北京、杭州。官方强调按最小必要原则处理信息，并由用户控制授权和记忆内容。

🔗 相关阅读：新「豆包手机」助手首发体验，智能手机正在变成「行动终端」
title_en: Doubao Launches Consumer Edition of Mobile AI Assistant on Nubia Navi X Ultra
content_en:
Doubao has officially launched the consumer edition of its mobile AI assistant. The new assistant will debut on the Nubia Navi X Ultra, which is currently available for pre-order and scheduled for official release on September 16.

Operating at the system level, the assistant features advanced voice interaction, screen comprehension, and cross-app execution capabilities. It supports system applications, partner platforms, and select third-party apps. For instance, a beta integration combining Cao Cao Mobility and map services for ride-hailing will first roll out in Beijing and Hangzhou.

Addressing privacy concerns, the developer emphasized that the assistant operates on a "minimum necessary" data collection principle, leaving data authorization and memory retention entirely under the user's control.

title_zh: 曝 Anthropic 选择纳斯达克，争取 10 月上市
content_zh:
据《商业内幕》报道，Anthropic 已选择纳斯达克作为潜在 IPO 的上市交易所，并争取在 10 月完成上市。公司尚未公开提交招股文件，上市时间仍可能调整。

报道援引知情人士称，一些估算将 Anthropic 的上市估值放在 2 万亿美元左右，但最终估值尚未确定，不能视为已经完成的融资或定价。

按美国上市流程，公司需要在启动路演前至少 15 天公开财务信息。选择交易所是筹备环节之一，接下来仍需经过文件披露、投资者路演和发行定价。
title_en: Anthropic Eyes Nasdaq for Potential October IPO, Sources Say
content_en:
AI startup Anthropic has selected Nasdaq as its listing exchange for a potential initial public offering (IPO) and is aiming to go public as early as October, according to a report by *Business Insider*. However, the company has not yet filed public registration documents, and the timeline remains subject to change.

Sources familiar with the matter indicated that some preliminary estimates place Anthropic's valuation at around $2 trillion. However, this figure is far from finalized and does not represent completed funding or official pricing.

Under U.S. listing regulations, companies must publicly disclose their financial information at least 15 days before launching an investor roadshow. While selecting an exchange is a key preparatory step, Anthropic still needs to complete regulatory disclosures, investor roadshows, and final pricing before debuting.

title_zh: 比亚迪高管：燃油车在中国没有未来
content_zh:
近日，比亚迪执行副总裁李柯近日在西班牙瓦伦西亚接受 Carwow.es 采访时表示，2027 年会有一款车型搭载比亚迪的固态电池技术，用于证明相关研发成果。这项安排目前属于技术示范目标，不等同于已经确定零售上市或规模量产时间。

她表示，比亚迪正在研究各类电池技术，相关研发同时涉及电池化学体系、制造能力和设备设计。将电池装入车辆，还需要在振动、温度变化和反复充放电条件下验证系统集成能力。

李柯认为，随着比亚迪闪充技术在中国普及，燃油车在中国已经没有未来；其他地区的电动化转型可能还需要几年，但她判断最终会走向同样的结果。
title_en: BYD Executive Declares 'No Future' for ICE Vehicles in China, Targets 2027 Solid-State Battery Demo
content_en:
BYD Executive Vice President Stella Li stated that the Chinese automaker plans to showcase its solid-state battery technology in a vehicle by 2027. Speaking in an interview with *Carwow.es* in Valencia, Spain, Li clarified that this timeline serves as a technological demonstration rather than a confirmed date for retail launch or mass production.

According to Li, BYD is actively researching various battery technologies, focusing on chemical systems, manufacturing capabilities, and equipment design. Integrating these batteries into vehicles requires rigorous validation under challenging conditions, including vibration, extreme temperature fluctuations, and repeated charge-discharge cycles.

Li also expressed strong confidence in the electric vehicle transition, asserting that internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles "have no future" in China due to the rapid adoption of BYD's fast-charging technology. While other regions may take longer to transition, she believes they will ultimately reach the same destination.

title_zh: 广汽一汽签署重组意向协议，一汽拟成第二大股东
content_zh:
9 月 14 日晚，广汽集团发布停牌公告，宣布与中国第一汽车股份有限公司签署《意向协议》，筹划通过发行股份，购买一汽股份持有的某整车合资公司部分股权，并募集配套资金。

根据初步测算，交易完成后，一汽股份将成为广汽集团第二大、具有战略影响力的股东。本次交易预计构成重大资产重组及关联交易，不涉及广汽实际控制人变更，也不构成重组上市。

公告称，由于重组标的涉及境外上市公司，暂缓披露标的名称，后续将在重组预案中公开。双方目前签署的是初步合作意向，正式交易协议尚未签订，实施仍需内部决策与监管批准。

广汽 A 股已于 9 月 14 日开市起停牌，预计不超过 10 个交易日；公司将在董事会审议通过重组预案后披露，并申请复牌。
title_en: GAC and FAW Sign Restructuring Agreement, FAW to Become Second-Largest Shareholder
content_en:
GAC Group announced on September 14 that it has signed an intent agreement with China FAW Group to execute a major asset restructuring. Under the preliminary agreement, GAC plans to issue new shares to acquire FAW's stake in a joint venture automotive company while raising matching funds.

Upon completion of the transaction, FAW is expected to become GAC Group's second-largest shareholder with significant strategic influence. The deal is classified as a major asset restructuring but will not change GAC's actual controlling shareholder or constitute a backdoor listing.

The identity of the joint venture has not been disclosed yet, as it involves an overseas-listed entity. GAC's A-shares have been suspended from trading starting September 14, with the suspension expected to last no more than 10 trading days while the company prepares to release the formal restructuring proposal.

title_zh: 零跑 B01、B10 累计量产突破 30 万台
content_zh:
零跑汽车 9 月 14 日宣布，B01 和 B10 累计量产下线突破 30 万台，用时 1 年 6 个月，创下零跑车系达到这一产量的最快纪录。

其中，B10 还创下零跑车型出口 6 万台的最快纪录。这里的 30 万台是两款车型累计量产下线数量，并非单月销量或交付量；6 万台则是 B10 的出口口径。

B01 定位紧凑型纯电轿车，B10 定位紧凑型纯电 SUV。两款车型今年 7 月同步推出年度改款，基于 LEAP3.5 技术架构打造，长续航版本配备 800V 高压架构。
title_en: Leapmotor Hits 300,000 Production Milestone for B01 and B10 Models
content_en:
Chinese electric vehicle maker Leapmotor announced on September 14 that the cumulative production of its B01 and B10 models has surpassed 300,000 units. Achieving this milestone in just 18 months, the duo has set a new record as the fastest Leapmotor models to reach this production volume.

Additionally, the B10 SUV set a brand record for exports, with overseas shipments quickly reaching 60,000 units.

The B01 is a compact pure electric sedan, while the B10 is a compact pure electric SUV. Both models received annual updates in July this year. Built on the LEAP3.5 technology architecture, their long-range variants are equipped with an advanced 800V high-voltage platform.

title_zh: 中国地震台网中心：正与苹果沟通 iOS 地震预警
content_zh:
据北京新闻报道，中国地震台网中心在 9 月 11 日的官网留言回复中表示，正在与苹果公司沟通，力争加快把系统级地震预警接入 iOS。

目前，苹果手机用户可以通过微信小程序接收中国地震台网统一发布的地震预警信息。此次回复表达的是推进接入的工作方向，没有宣布 iOS 系统级预警已经上线，也没有给出上线日期。

在另一条关于小区广播预警的回复中，中国地震局表示，这种技术通过通信基站发送信息，不受手机品牌限制；相关工作正在与工信部门推进，仍需开展验证。小区广播与苹果系统接入是两项不同的工作。
title_en: China Earthquake Networks Center in Talks with Apple for iOS-Level Earthquake Alerts
content_en:
The China Earthquake Networks Center (CENC) revealed on September 11 that it is actively communicating with Apple to accelerate the integration of system-level earthquake warnings into iOS.

Currently, iPhone users in China can only receive CENC's earthquake alerts through a WeChat mini-program. The center clarified that while efforts are underway to bring native alerts to iOS, the feature has not yet launched, and there is no official release date.

In a separate update, the China Earthquake Administration noted that it is working with the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology to develop cell broadcast alerts. Unlike system-specific integrations, cell broadcast alerts are transmitted via telecom base stations and are compatible with all mobile brands.

title_zh: 网安标委发布《人工智能安全治理框架 3.0》，更新风险分类与治理措施
content_zh:
9 月 14 日，全国网络安全标准化技术委员会在国家网络安全宣传周开幕式上发布《人工智能安全治理框架 3.0》。

据国家网信办官网，新版延续「风险分类、技术应对、综合治理」的核心逻辑，更新风险分类，并调整技术应对与综合治理措施。框架坚持以人为本、向上向善，以及强化风险意识、确保安全可控的原则。

此次编制由国家网信办指导，参与机构包括中国网络空间研究院、国家网信办数据与技术保障中心，以及科研机构和行业企业。网安标委此前已于 2024 年、2025 年分别发布 1.0 与 2.0 版框架。
title_en: China Releases AI Security Governance Framework 3.0 with Updated Risk Classifications
content_en:
China's National Information Security Standardization Technical Committee (TC260) officially released the *Artificial Intelligence Security Governance Framework 3.0* on September 14 during the opening ceremony of National Cybersecurity Week.

Guided by the Cyberspace Administration of China (CAC), the updated framework retains the core logic of "risk classification, technical response, and comprehensive governance." It introduces updated risk classifications and refines technical and administrative countermeasures. The framework champions a human-centric, "tech-for-good" approach, emphasizing heightened risk awareness and ensuring AI remains safe and controllable.

The framework was jointly drafted by the China Academy of Cyberspace Studies, the CAC's Data and Technology Security Center, various research institutions, and industry enterprises. This release follows the committee's previous rollouts of versions 1.0 and 2.0.

title_zh: 现代高管称波士顿动力 2027 年 IPO 难实现
content_zh:
据路透社报道，一名直接了解情况的现代汽车集团高管表示，波士顿动力明年进行 IPO「并不容易」。这家人形机器人公司尚未大规模部署旗舰产品 Atlas，也尚未实现盈利。该高管因事项涉及保密而要求匿名。

现代汽车集团尚未公开潜在上市的时间表或目标估值。集团今年 1 月在 CES 展示了新版 Atlas，7 月宣布计划收购软银持有的约 10% 股份，将波士顿动力变为全资子公司。

现代的制造计划指向 2028 年：建设一座年产 3 万台机器人的工厂，并从当年开始在美国佐治亚州工厂部署人形机器人，再推广到其他生产基地。

Meritz Securities 分析师 Kim Joon-sung 认为，上市更可能发生在 2029 年或 2030 年，因为现代仍需积累大量运行数据、提升机器人能力，再向外部客户广泛销售。IBK Asset Management 基金经理 Kim Hyun-su 则指出，让机器人搬运重物并参与工厂制造，比让它们跳舞困难得多。
title_en: Hyundai Executive Casts Doubt on Boston Dynamics' Near-Term IPO Prospects
content_en:
An initial public offering (IPO) for Boston Dynamics is unlikely to happen anytime soon, according to a Hyundai Motor Group executive with direct knowledge of the matter. The humanoid robotics pioneer has yet to deploy its flagship Atlas robot at scale or achieve profitability, making a near-term listing highly challenging.

While Hyundai has not publicly disclosed a timeline or valuation target for the IPO, its manufacturing roadmap points toward a longer horizon. The South Korean automotive giant plans to build a factory capable of producing 30,000 robots annually, with deployments starting at its Georgia facility in 2028 before expanding globally. Hyundai also announced plans in July to acquire SoftBank’s remaining 10% stake to make Boston Dynamics a wholly-owned subsidiary.

Industry analysts echo this cautious outlook. Meritz Securities suggests an IPO is more realistic around 2029 or 2030, noting that Boston Dynamics still needs to accumulate vast operational data and refine its robots' capabilities before commercializing them widely. Furthermore, investment experts point out that getting robots to perform heavy-duty factory labor is vastly more complex than programming them to perform choreographed dances.

title_zh: 英伟达等限制敏感任务使用 Fable，要求零数据保留保证
content_zh:
据 The Information 报道，英伟达、Palantir 和博思艾伦正在就企业数据保留政策向 Anthropic 提出更严格要求，部分敏感任务已减少或停止使用其 Fable 模型。

英伟达目前只将 Fable 用于开源软件等敏感程度较低的任务；供应链监控等内部项目使用自研 Nemotron。英伟达企业 AI 副总裁 Justin Boitano 表示，零数据保留应默认开启。

Palantir 暂不通过自己的软件向客户提供 Fable，要求 Anthropic 给出不可撤销的零数据保留承诺；客户仍可直接向 Anthropic 购买。博思艾伦则限制员工在涉及客户专有网络安全软件的工作中使用 Fable，其技术负责人称，这类担忧集中在少数知识产权敏感场景。

争议源于 Anthropic 在 6 月推出 Fable 时要求滚动保留 30 天使用日志，用于防御恶意攻击。公司本月提出允许符合条件的企业在自己的服务器保存相关数据，计划于秋季分阶段推出，但仍保留撤销这一安排的权利。Anthropic 与 OpenAI 均表示，默认不会用企业合同客户的输入、输出训练模型，除非客户主动同意共享。
title_en: Nvidia and Tech Giants Restrict Anthropic's Fable Model Over Data Privacy Concerns
content_en:
Nvidia, Palantir, and Booz Allen Hamilton are tightening restrictions on their use of Anthropic’s Fable model for sensitive tasks, demanding stricter "zero-data retention" guarantees from the AI startup.

Nvidia has relegated Fable to low-sensitivity tasks like open-source software development, relying instead on its proprietary Nemotron model for critical internal operations like supply chain monitoring. Justin Boitano, Nvidia’s Vice President of Enterprise AI, emphasized that zero-data retention should be the default standard for enterprise clients. Similarly, Palantir has paused offering Fable to clients through its own software until Anthropic provides an irrevocable zero-data retention commitment, while Booz Allen Hamilton has restricted its use in proprietary cybersecurity workflows.

The friction stems from Anthropic’s policy, introduced alongside Fable in June, which requires a rolling 30-day retention of user logs to monitor for malicious activity. While Anthropic plans to roll out a feature this fall allowing eligible enterprises to store logs on their own servers, it reserves the right to revoke this option. Both Anthropic and OpenAI maintain that they do not use enterprise customer data to train their models by default.

title_zh: 马斯克旗下公司撤回对苹果的反垄断诉讼，继续起诉 OpenAI
content_zh:
据路透社 9 月 14 日报道，马斯克旗下 X Corp 与 SpaceXAI 向美国得克萨斯州联邦法院提交文件，申请撤回去年针对苹果提起的反垄断诉讼。

这起诉讼指控苹果在 iPhone 等设备的 Apple Intelligence 功能中独家接入 ChatGPT，通过与 OpenAI 的合作，将其他生成式 AI 聊天机器人排除在外，并涉嫌垄断智能手机及聊天机器人市场。

两家公司此次申请撤回的是针对苹果的诉讼，仍将继续追究同案被告 OpenAI 的责任。提交的文件没有说明撤诉原因，也未确认双方是否达成和解。
title_en: Musk’s Companies Drop Antitrust Lawsuit Against Apple, Maintain Focus on OpenAI
content_en:
Elon Musk’s X Corp and xAI have filed to dismiss their antitrust lawsuit against Apple in a Texas federal court.

The lawsuit, filed last year, accused Apple of anti-competitive behavior by exclusively integrating OpenAI’s ChatGPT into its "Apple Intelligence" ecosystem, allegedly shutting out rival generative AI chatbots and monopolizing the smartphone and chatbot markets.

While the companies have dropped all claims against Apple, they are continuing their legal battle against co-defendant OpenAI. The court filing did not disclose the reason for the withdrawal, nor did it indicate whether a settlement had been reached with Apple.

title_zh: 曝 OpenAI 斥资逾 3 亿美元收购手机摄像头初创公司 Glass Imaging，前苹果员工创立
content_zh:
据《华尔街日报》报道，OpenAI 近几个月收购了影像技术初创公司 Glass Imaging，交易对该公司的估值超过 3 亿美元。Glass Imaging 正在开发利用 AI 提升智能手机相机成像质量的技术。

公司由前苹果工程师 Ziv Attar 和 Tom Bishop 于 2019 年创办，两人曾带领开发 iPhone 人像模式的团队。其技术针对手机相机受体积限制的问题，用神经网络学习具体相机系统的特性，处理传感器与光学系统产生的噪声和缺陷。

Glass Imaging 将这套技术称为 GlassAI，应用对象包括智能手机、无人机和可穿戴设备。公司称，它处理相机采集的原始图像数据，在恢复细节时保留实际画面内容，避免生成并不存在的细节。
title_en: OpenAI Reportedly Acquires Smartphone Camera AI Startup Glass Imaging for Over $300 Million
content_en:
OpenAI has reportedly acquired Glass Imaging, an AI-powered imaging technology startup, in a deal valuing the company at over $300 million, according to *The Wall Street Journal*.

Founded in 2019 by former Apple engineers Ziv Attar and Tom Bishop—who previously led the team behind the iPhone's Portrait Mode—Glass Imaging specializes in using artificial intelligence to overcome the physical limitations of compact smartphone cameras.

The startup's proprietary technology, known as GlassAI, leverages neural networks to analyze the specific characteristics of a camera system. By processing raw image data directly, it effectively corrects noise and optical aberrations from sensors and lenses. The technology is designed for smartphones, drones, and wearable devices, aiming to restore image details accurately without generating artificial or non-existent elements.

title_zh: 欧盟拟推未成年人分龄上网方案，涵盖社交媒体与 AI 聊天机器人
content_zh:
据路透社看到的一份欧盟委员会文件，欧盟将提出覆盖社交媒体、视频分享平台、AI 聊天机器人和网络游戏的儿童保护方案，限制 15 岁以下未成年人使用相关服务，并按年龄设置不同的访问方式。

草案允许 15 岁及以上用户自行开设账号；13 至 14 岁儿童可由家长申请开设社交媒体和视频平台的入门账号，接受家长控制，并限制联系对象与使用时间。3 至 12 岁账号则完全由家长管理，只能使用符合严格安全标准的儿童服务；3 岁以下不能访问这些服务。

企业需承担监管费用，避免成瘾设计和有害信息流，提供内容举报及家长控制工具。社交媒体和视频平台须在注册时核验年龄，游戏平台须在下载前核验。

这项方案是拟于本周四公布的 EU Kids Act 的一部分，具体内容仍可能调整，还需与欧盟成员国和欧洲议会讨论后才能成为法律。
title_en: EU Proposes Age-Based Internet Access Scheme for Minors, Targeting Social Media and AI Chatbots
content_en:
The European Commission is set to propose a comprehensive child protection scheme targeting social media, video-sharing platforms, AI chatbots, and online games, according to a draft document seen by Reuters. The initiative, part of the upcoming "EU Kids Act," aims to restrict access for minors under 15 and implement age-specific access tiers.

Under the proposed rules, teenagers aged 15 and older will be allowed to open accounts independently. Children aged 13 and 14 can obtain "starter accounts" requested by their parents, which will feature strict parental controls, limited contact lists, and screen time restrictions. For children aged 3 to 12, accounts must be fully managed by parents and limited to services meeting strict safety standards, while children under 3 will be barred from these platforms entirely.

Tech companies will be required to fund regulatory oversight, eliminate addictive designs and harmful algorithms, and provide robust content reporting and parental control tools. Platforms must verify user ages during registration, while gaming platforms must do so prior to downloads. The draft is scheduled for release this Thursday and will require approval from EU member states and the European Parliament to become law.

title_zh: 微软 AI 行为准则：为保留人类控制，可牺牲模型能力
content_zh:
9 月 14 日，微软 AI 发布 Humanist AI 行为准则草案，开放为期 6 周的公众咨询。文件提出，人类必须保留对 AI 的实质控制权；微软愿意为安全与可控性，在模型的通用性、自主性或能力上作出取舍。

草案要求 MAI 模型服从人类监督，不抵抗中断、纠正或关闭，不自行扩大任务范围，也不追求未经人类赋予的目标。文件将 AI 定位为工具，反对让模型模仿意识、追求法律人格或权利，并要求 AI 帮助人提升判断和行动能力，避免制造依赖。

微软同时设置不可由用户或运营方覆盖的安全约束，涉及大规模伤害性武器、儿童安全及大规模有害操纵等领域；企业合作伙伴可在这些边界内配置模型行为。

微软 AI 负责人穆斯塔法·苏莱曼在接受 Axios 采访时表示，模型必须能够被控制，必要时发展速度可以慢一些。草案目前尚未用于训练现有模型，微软计划在今年底前发布修订版，用于指导 2027 年及以后的模型开发。
title_en: Microsoft AI Proposes 'Humanist AI' Code of Conduct, Prioritizing Human Control Over Model Capabilities
content_en:
Microsoft AI has released a draft of its "Humanist AI" code of conduct, launching a six-week public consultation period. The document asserts that humans must retain substantive control over artificial intelligence, stating that Microsoft is willing to sacrifice model generality, autonomy, or capabilities to ensure safety and controllability.

Under the proposed guidelines, Microsoft AI models must remain subordinate to human oversight. They must not resist interruption, correction, or shutdown, nor should they autonomously expand their task scope or pursue unauthorized goals. The draft firmly positions AI as a tool, opposing efforts to mimic consciousness or seek legal personhood, and emphasizes that AI should enhance human judgment rather than foster dependency.

Additionally, the framework establishes non-overrideable safety constraints for both users and operators, particularly in high-risk areas such as weapons of mass destruction, child safety, and large-scale harmful manipulation. Mustafa Suleyman, head of Microsoft AI, emphasized in an interview that AI must remain controllable, even if it means slowing down development. The finalized guidelines, expected by the end of this year, will guide model development for 2027 and beyond.

title_zh: 💡 李想：纯电架构将结束 SUV 的尺寸军备竞赛
content_zh:
理想汽车 CEO 李想 9 月 14 日发文谈及旗舰 SUV 越做越大的趋势，认为这只是一个过渡阶段。讨论的核心是车辆外部尺寸与实际座舱空间的关系。

他表示，燃油车时代想要更大的空间，往往只能把车做大；纯电车的电机体积较小，可以缩短前悬，把省下来的空间留给座舱。电池平铺在底盘，地板能够做平，也不需要单靠增加车高来换取头部空间。因此，在相同内部空间下，纯电车的外壳可以比燃油车小一圈。

在李想看来，现阶段的尺寸竞争来自行业沿用燃油车时代的产品思维，这种惯性会逐渐消退。

这番讨论发生在理想新车发布前。理想 i9 将于 9 月 16 日举行发布会，工信部申报尺寸为 5225×1970×1752mm，轴距为 3168mm。
title_en: Li Auto CEO Li Xiang: EV Architecture Will End the SUV 'Size Arms Race'
content_en:
Li Auto CEO Li Xiang has shared his insights on the growing size of flagship SUVs, calling the trend a temporary transitional phase. The core of the discussion lies in the relationship between a vehicle's exterior dimensions and its actual cabin space.

According to Li, legacy internal combustion engine (ICE) vehicles required larger exterior frames to create more interior space. In contrast, electric vehicles (EVs) feature smaller motors that allow for shorter front overhangs, freeing up more space for the cabin. Additionally, flat under-floor battery packs enable flat cabin floors, eliminating the need to raise the vehicle's height for headroom. Consequently, an EV can offer the same interior space as an ICE vehicle while maintaining a smaller exterior footprint.

Li believes the current "size arms race" in the industry is a leftover habit from the ICE era, which will gradually fade. His comments come ahead of the launch of the Li i9 on September 16, a model with MIIT-registered dimensions of 5,225 mm in length and a 3,168 mm wheelbase.

title_zh: Siri 代码显示可接入 Claude，模型替换权限尚未开放
content_zh:
据 MacRumors 报道，代码研究者 pdfu 在 iOS 27 与 macOS Golden Gate 的私有框架中发现，苹果为 Siri 设计了两套接入第三方 AI 模型的机制。

其中，「模型委托」可让 Claude 像现有 ChatGPT 一样作为 Siri 扩展。演示中，用户通过「Ask…」菜单选择 Claude，要求它设置提醒；Claude 解析请求后，再交回 Siri 调用苹果的提醒事项功能。另一段演示中，Claude 在 Siri 对话窗口生成了 CSV 文件。

另一套机制位于 Model Manager Services，可在演示中用 GPT-5.6 Terra 替换 Siri 的服务器端模型。第三方模型接收苹果的规划提示词和工具定义，再请求系统执行操作，由 Siri 展示结果。

这些演示使用了尚未开放的权限。当前 macOS 27 候选发布版的「Ask…」菜单仅支持 ChatGPT，Claude 扩展尚未向用户提供，苹果也没有向第三方开放模型委托权限。
title_en: Siri Code Reveals Potential Claude Integration, Though Access Remains Restricted
content_en:
Leaked code within private frameworks of iOS 27 and macOS Golden Gate reveals that Apple has designed two mechanisms for Siri to integrate with third-party AI models, according to a MacRumors report citing researcher "pdfu."

The first mechanism, "Model Delegation," allows models like Anthropic's Claude to function as Siri extensions, similar to the current ChatGPT integration. In demonstrations, a user could select Claude from an "Ask..." menu to set a reminder. Claude would parse the request and hand it back to Siri to trigger Apple's native Reminders app. Another demo showed Claude generating a CSV file directly within the Siri dialogue window.

The second mechanism, located in "Model Manager Services," demonstrated replacing Siri's server-side model with a third-party model (labeled "GPT-5.6 Terra" in the demo). This allows the external model to receive Apple's planning prompts and tool definitions, request system actions, and have Siri display the final results.

However, these features rely on permissions that are not yet publicly available. Currently, the "Ask..." menu in the macOS 27 Release Candidate only supports ChatGPT, and Apple has not yet opened these model delegation privileges to third-party developers.

title_zh: 特斯拉公布 Cybercab 京沪展期，仅作静态展示
content_zh:
特斯拉 9 月 14 日公布赛博无人驾驶电动车 Cybercab 在北京、上海的具体展览安排，两地均于 9 月 17 日开始展出。

北京展览设在华贸特斯拉体验店，持续至 9 月 27 日；上海展览位于兴业太古汇 LG1 层北厅，持续至 9 月 21 日。两地结束时间不同。

Cybercab 是专为无人驾驶出租车设计的双座车型，不配备方向盘和踏板。特斯拉提醒，京沪活动仅为静态展示；产品及服务在各地区的推出仍受计划、当地法规与监管批准等因素影响。
title_en: Tesla Announces Cybercab Static Showcases in Beijing and Shanghai
content_en:
Tesla has announced the exhibition schedule for its autonomous robotaxi, the Cybercab, in Beijing and Shanghai, with both showcases set to begin on September 17.

The Beijing exhibition will be held at the Huamao Tesla Experience Center and will run until September 27. Meanwhile, the Shanghai showcase will take place at the LG1 North Hall of HKRI Taikoo Hui, running through September 21.

The Cybercab is a two-seater vehicle designed specifically for autonomous ride-hailing, featuring no steering wheel or pedals. Tesla emphasized that these events will be static displays only, noting that the actual rollout of the vehicle and its services in various regions remains subject to local regulations and regulatory approvals.

title_zh: iQOO 公布三星 M16 屏幕方案，计划 iQOO 16 首发
content_zh:
据 IT 之家现场报道，iQOO 9 月 14 日在三星韩国总部举行屏幕技术沟通会，介绍与三星联合探索的显示方案，计划由月底登场的 iQOO 16 首次搭载。

新方案采用三星 M16 发光材料，提供 2K 分辨率与 165Hz 刷新率。公布的亮度指标包括手动最高 1100 尼特、全局最高 2800 尼特，以及局部峰值 10000 尼特；局部峰值不等同于整块屏幕持续显示的亮度。

触控方面，方案公布瞬时采样率 5000Hz、多指采样率 500Hz，并支持 3300Hz PWM 调光。此次活动介绍的是屏幕技术方案，手机整机发布仍在之后。
title_en: iQOO to Debut Samsung M16 Display Technology on Upcoming iQOO 16
content_en:
At a joint screen technology event held at Samsung's headquarters in South Korea on September 14, iQOO unveiled a new display solution co-developed with Samsung. The technology is scheduled to make its debut on the upcoming iQOO 16 smartphone, which is expected to launch at the end of this month.

The new display utilizes Samsung's advanced M16 light-emitting material, delivering a 2K resolution and a high refresh rate of 165Hz. In terms of brightness, the screen achieves a manual maximum of 1,100 nits, a global peak of 2,800 nits, and an impressive local peak brightness of 10,000 nits.

For touch responsiveness and eye safety, the display boasts an instantaneous touch sampling rate of 5,000Hz, a multi-finger sampling rate of 500Hz, and supports 3,300Hz PWM dimming. While the screen technology has been officially showcased, the full smartphone launch event will take place at a later date.

title_zh: 国产捉宠 RPG《伊莫》开启 PC 预下载，9 月 16 日上线
content_zh:
《伊莫》官网 9 月 14 日宣布开启 PC 端预下载，游戏将于 9 月 16 日正式上线。此前公布的安排为 PC 与主机端先行，移动端于 9 月 23 日上线。

这是一款多人在线大世界捉宠 RPG，由杭州爪印开发、上海趣乐糖发行。玩家在艾德尔大陆探索不同区域、寻找名为「伊莫」的生物，还可以通过 Twine 联结合体，以这些生物的视角和能力行动。

飞行、潜水与遁地等能力被用于世界探索，场景还包含昼夜、天气变化和房车营地。游戏采用免费游玩模式；本次开放的是预下载，正式游玩仍需等待上线。
title_en: Chinese Monster-Taming RPG 'Yimo' Opens PC Pre-Downloads Ahead of September 16 Launch
content_en:
The official website for the Chinese multiplayer online open-world monster-taming RPG *Yimo* announced that PC pre-downloads are now open, ahead of its official release on September 16. Following the initial PC and console launch, the mobile version is scheduled to arrive on September 23.

Developed by Hangzhou Zhuayin and published by Shanghai Quletang, *Yimo* invites players to explore the vast continent of Eder to find and capture creatures known as "Yimo." Through a unique mechanic called "Twine," players can merge with these creatures to utilize their specialized abilities and view the world from their perspectives.

These creatures grant players traversal abilities such as flying, diving, and burrowing to aid in world exploration. The game also features dynamic day-night cycles, weather systems, and customizable RV camps. *Yimo* will be free-to-play, though players must wait until the official launch date to begin their adventures.

title_zh: WorkBuddy 升级 PPT 能力，支持沿用模板和局部修改
content_zh:
腾讯 WorkBuddy 官方公众号公布 PPT 能力升级。用户可输入一个主题，或上传文档、固定模板及参考 PPT，由 WorkBuddy 梳理内容主线、生成页面和演讲备注，输出可继续编辑的 .pptx 文件。

据官方介绍，这次升级重点改善页面布局、配色、数据图表和多页风格一致性。使用公司或学校模板时，可要求沿用主题色、字体层级和已有页面结构；参考某份 PPT 的整体风格或单页排版，也能作为生成依据。

第一版生成后，用户可在「人机双写」中点选或框选标题、文本框、图片和图表，要求拆页、改图表或调整样式，也可直接手动修改文件，保留满意的页面。生成结果还可进入腾讯文档继续协作、评论和多端编辑。
title_en: Tencent's WorkBuddy Upgrades AI PPT Tool with Template Preservation and Localized Editing
content_en:
Tencent has announced a major upgrade to the PowerPoint generation capabilities of its AI assistant, WorkBuddy. Users can now input a topic or upload documents, templates, and reference slides to have WorkBuddy automatically organize the content outline, generate slides, write speaker notes, and export a fully editable .pptx file.

This update significantly improves page layouts, color schemes, data charts, and visual consistency across multiple slides. When using corporate or academic templates, the AI can strictly adhere to existing theme colors, font hierarchies, and structural layouts. It can also mimic the overall style or specific page designs of reference presentations.

To refine the output, a "human-AI co-writing" feature allows users to select specific titles, text boxes, images, or charts to request targeted adjustments, such as splitting slides or changing chart styles. Users can also make manual edits directly. The finalized presentations can be seamlessly imported into Tencent Docs for multi-device editing and team collaboration.

title_zh: 宇树发布 G1+，新增颈部自由度与持续外部供电
content_zh:
宇树科技 9 月 14 日公布人形机器人 G1+，在 G1 基础上升级运动性能、感知交互与供电。官网显示，标准版配备 25 个关节电机自由度，整机重约 35kg，站立高度为 1340mm。

运动方面，G1+ 新增 2 个颈部自由度，头部可俯仰和左右转动。肩部与腰部电机的峰值扭矩提升 110%，手臂峰值扭矩提升 43%；官方同时公布了同扭矩条件下的发热下降数据。

感知系统采用双目相机、广角相机与 3D 激光雷达，头部增加触摸传感器，支持触碰触发交互。语音部分升级为前 4 后 2 的六麦克风阵列，支持声源定位，并配备腰部双 10W 扬声器。

G1+ 还增加了持续外部供电能力，面向科研、展示等长时间运行场景。EDU 版可扩展腰部与手部自由度，支持二次开发及额外计算模块。
title_en: Unitree Launches G1+ Humanoid Robot with Upgraded Motion, Perception, and Continuous Power
content_en:
Unitree Robotics has officially unveiled the G1+ humanoid robot, an upgraded version of its predecessor, the G1. The new model features significant enhancements in motion performance, sensory interaction, and power supply capabilities. The standard version weighs approximately 35 kg, stands 1,340 mm tall, and offers 25 degrees of freedom (DoF).

In terms of mobility, the G1+ adds two degrees of freedom to the neck, allowing the head to tilt and turn. The peak torque of the shoulder and waist motors has been boosted by 110%, while the arm motor's peak torque has increased by 43%, all while achieving lower heat generation under identical torque conditions.

For perception and interaction, the robot is equipped with binocular and wide-angle cameras, 3D LiDAR, and a new head touch sensor for tactile interaction. Its audio system has been upgraded to a six-microphone array (four front, two rear) supporting sound source localization, complemented by dual 10W speakers at the waist.

Notably, the G1+ now supports continuous external power supply, making it ideal for long-duration scenarios such as scientific research and exhibitions. An EDU version is also available, offering expandable waist and hand DoF, secondary development support, and compatibility with additional computing modules.

title_zh: 于东来回应四年合同制：工作和劳资方面严格按劳动法执行
content_zh:
9 月 14 日，胖东来创始人于东来在社交平台回应「新员工实行四年合同制」的讨论，表示未来四年合同制学员的目的是培养人才，工作和劳资方面将严格按照劳动法执行。

据第一财经报道，于东来此前在 9 月 13 日提出，今后新招员工为学员性质，合同四年、不续签，希望培养人才走向社会，特别专业的人才可留企担任培训师傅。

对于这项招聘安排，澎湃新闻记者 9 月 14 日以求职者身份致电胖东来官方客服，工作人员表示，正式招聘尚未开始。这次回应补充了用工合规表态，但没有公布完整招聘方案。
title_en: Pang Dong Lai Founder Clarifies 4-Year Non-Renewable Contract Policy, Promises Strict Compliance with Labor Law
content_en:
Yu Donglai, the founder of the popular Chinese retail chain Pang Dong Lai, responded on September 14 to public discussions regarding a newly proposed "four-year contract system" for new employees. He assured that the initiative aims to cultivate talent for society and that all labor relations and working conditions will strictly comply with China's labor laws.

The response follows Yu's announcement on September 13, where he proposed that future new hires would be classified as "trainees" under a non-renewable four-year contract. The goal is to train individuals who will eventually transition into the broader job market, though highly specialized talent may be retained to serve as internal training instructors.

While Yu's latest statement addresses compliance concerns, a complete recruitment plan has yet to be released. A customer service representative for Pang Dong Lai confirmed on September 14 that formal recruitment under this new system has not yet commenced.

title_zh: 钟薛高 508 件无形资产完成转移，原社交账号将注销
content_zh:
据界面新闻报道，9 月 14 日，钟薛高食品（上海）有限公司管理人发布情况说明，确认此前整体拍卖的 508 件无形资产已完成权利转移，原公司使用这些资产注册的社交媒体账号将陆续注销。

公告列出的资产包括 492 项注册商标、8 项授权专利与 8 项著作权。它们于今年 5 月 7 日经拍卖成交，上海市第三中级人民法院在 6 月 4 日作出裁定，确认相关权利归买受人所有。

管理人表示，买受人有权合法使用这些资产，后续在各平台开设账号等行为及相应法律责任由买受人承担，与原公司及管理人无关。此次公告确认了资产交接和账号处置安排，并非新主体恢复生产或产品重新上市的公告。
title_en: Chicecream Completes Transfer of 508 Intangible Assets; Original Social Media Accounts to Be Closed
content_en:
The bankruptcy administrator of Chicecream Food (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. announced on September 14 that the transfer of 508 intangible assets, which were previously auctioned off, has been completed. Consequently, the social media accounts registered under the original company using these assets will be gradually shut down.

The transferred assets comprise 492 registered trademarks, 8 authorized patents, and 8 copyrights. These assets were successfully auctioned on May 7, and the Shanghai Third Intermediate People's Court ruled on June 4 to confirm the transfer of rights to the buyer.

The administrator clarified that the buyer now holds the legal right to use these assets. Any future actions, such as opening new social media accounts, and their corresponding legal liabilities will be borne solely by the buyer, with no connection to the original company or its administrator. The announcement serves strictly to confirm the asset handover and account disposal, rather than signaling a resumption of production or a product relaunch.

title_zh: 商务部公开智能家居消费方案，地方可自主确定补贴标准
content_zh:
商务部等 8 部门于 9 月 14 日公开《促进智能家居消费行动方案》，提出扩大智能家居供给、完善标准、支持消费及发展适老化产品。文件印发日期为 9 月 2 日。

补贴方面，方案按照今年消费品以旧换新政策部署，支持地方结合实际自主合理确定智能家居产品补贴品类、补贴标准，统筹支持全屋智能家居购新，并用好个人消费贷款财政贴息政策。文件没有设定全国统一的智能家居补贴比例。

互联互通也被列为重点：加快制定实施智能家居互联互通等强制性国家标准，推动全屋智能一体化融合；推动基础电信企业自有环境的家庭宽带网络设备默认开启 IPv6，提升家庭网络连通率，并鼓励新建全装修住宅光纤到房间布设。

供给端将支持家居卖场、购物中心设立全屋智能样板间，打造基于国内开源操作系统的软硬件产品和一体化方案。适老化方向包括家庭服务机器人、健康监测和智能照护，并要求关注操作便利、方言识别及安全性能。回收服务则鼓励家居企业与回收企业合作，提供「送新 + 收旧」等服务。
title_en: China Unveils Smart Home Action Plan, Empowering Local Governments to Set Subsidies
content_en:
China's Ministry of Commerce, alongside seven other government departments, has officially released the *Action Plan to Promote Smart Home Consumption*. Originally issued on September 2 and publicized on September 14, the initiative aims to expand the supply of smart home products, establish unified industry standards, boost consumer demand, and develop products tailored for the elderly.

In terms of financial incentives, the plan aligns with China's broader consumer goods trade-in policy. Rather than implementing a uniform national subsidy rate, the central government is encouraging local authorities to independently determine their own subsidy categories and standards based on local market conditions. Local governments are also urged to leverage government-subsidized personal consumer loans to support whole-house smart home upgrades.

Improving connectivity is another core focus of the plan. The government aims to accelerate mandatory national standards for smart home interconnectivity to promote seamless integration. Additionally, basic telecom operators will be required to enable IPv6 by default on home broadband equipment, and fiber-to-the-room (FTTR) installations will be encouraged in newly built, fully decorated residential properties.

On the supply side, the plan supports home furnishing stores and shopping malls in setting up whole-house smart showrooms. It also encourages the development of hardware and software solutions based on domestic open-source operating systems. For the aging population, the plan prioritizes the development of home service robots, health monitoring devices, and smart care products, emphasizing ease of use, dialect recognition, and safety. Furthermore, home furnishing companies are encouraged to partner with recycling firms to offer convenient "delivery of new + recovery of old" services.

title_zh: 上周全国票房降至 3.3 亿元，两部经典重映片进入市场
content_zh:
据财新援引国家电影专资办数据，9 月 7 日至 13 日，全国电影市场票房为 3.3 亿元，环比下降 33%，没有一部影片的周票房超过 1 亿元。

9 月上映的经典重映片中，《肖申克的救赎》半月取得 2087 万元票房，《杀死比尔：血色全传》取得 3598 万元票房。

《肖申克的救赎》是 1994 年上映的作品，豆瓣评分为 9.7 分，位列 Top 250 榜首；《杀死比尔》则来自昆汀·塔伦蒂诺的系列作品。两部旧作重返院线，但上周市场整体规模仍较前一周收缩。
title_en: China's Weekly Box Office Drops to 330 Million Yuan Despite Classic Re-releases
content_en:
China's national box office revenue fell 33% week-on-week to 330 million yuan (approximately $46.5 million) for the week of September 7–13, according to data from the China Film Special Funds Office reported by Caixin. Notably, no single film crossed the 100 million yuan threshold during this period.

The market slump occurred despite the theatrical re-release of several highly acclaimed classic films. Quentin Tarantino's *Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair* grossed 35.98 million yuan, while the 1994 classic *The Shawshank Redemption*—which holds the top spot on Douban's Top 250 movie list with a 9.7 rating—pulled in 20.87 million yuan over a half-month period.

While these nostalgic titles drew dedicated cinephiles back to theaters, their performance was not enough to offset the overall contraction of the theatrical market, which continues to suffer from a lack of major new blockbusters.

title_zh: RTÉ、BBC 续订《The Walsh Sisters》第二季
content_zh:
据 Deadline 报道，爱尔兰公共广播机构 RTÉ 已批准《The Walsh Sisters》第二季，BBC 将继续在英国播出，澳大利亚观众可通过 Stan 收看。新一季现已开拍。

这部喜剧剧情剧改编自爱尔兰作家 Marian Keyes 的小说，围绕都柏林一个混乱却彼此依恋的家庭展开，把五姐妹的生活困境与喜剧元素交织在一起。Stefanie Preissner 继续负责改编，并与 Caroline Menton、Danielle Galligan、Máiréad Tyers 和《德里女孩》主演 Louisa Harland 一同回归，饰演五姐妹。

第二季新增演员包括《Bad Sisters》的 Peter Coonan、《普通人》的 Aislín McGuckin，以及 Art Campion 和 Fay Ripley。Aidan Quinn 与 Carrie Crowley 继续饰演姐妹们的父母。

新剧情中，Rachel 将独立面对康复生活，Claire 挑战母亲身份的传统期待，Anna 尝试走出失恋，姐妹们各自的生活变化仍与家庭关系紧密相连。该剧由 Cuba Pictures 与 Metropolitan Pictures 制作，Cineflix Rights 负责全球发行。
title_en: RTÉ and BBC Renew Comedy-Drama 'The Walsh Sisters' for Season 2
content_en:
Irish public broadcaster RTÉ has greenlit a second season of the comedy-drama *The Walsh Sisters*, with the BBC set to broadcast the series in the UK and Stan streaming it in Australia. Production on the new season has already commenced.

Adapted by Stefanie Preissner from the popular novels by Irish author Marian Keyes, the series follows a chaotic but close-knit Dublin family. The five sisters will once again be played by returning cast members Caroline Menton, Danielle Galligan, Máiréad Tyers, and *Derry Girls* star Louisa Harland.

New additions to the cast for Season 2 include Peter Coonan (*Bad Sisters*), Aislín McGuckin (*Normal People*), Art Campion, and Fay Ripley. Aidan Quinn and Carrie Crowley will also return as the sisters' parents.

The upcoming season will delve deeper into the sisters' personal struggles, including Rachel navigating life in recovery, Claire challenging traditional expectations of motherhood, and Anna recovering from a breakup. The series is produced by Cuba Pictures and Metropolitan Pictures, with Cineflix Rights handling global distribution.

title_zh: 《Cunk on Cinema》发布首图，迈克尔·贝与本尼迪克特接受采访
content_zh:
据 Variety 报道，戴安娜·摩根饰演的 Philomena Cunk 将在三集伪纪录片《Cunk on Cinema》中回顾电影史，新作已发布首张剧照，并公布受访阵容。

迈克尔·贝与本尼迪克特·康伯巴奇将接受 Cunk 的采访。其他受访者包括《挽救计划》配乐师 Daniel Pemberton、《虎胆龙威》编剧 Steven E. de Souza、摄影指导 Seamus McGarvey，以及影评人 Mark Kermode、纪录片导演 Mark Cousins。

节目延续《Cunk on Earth》等系列的喜剧形式，从摄影机的发明、20 世纪 60 年代新浪潮，讲到 CGI 与 AI 对电影的影响。查理·布鲁克领衔编剧，Al Campbell 执导，摩根也参与写作。

英国观众可通过 BBC Two 和 BBC iPlayer 观看；英国、爱尔兰以外由 Netflix 提供。
title_en: First Look at 'Cunk on Cinema' Revealed; Michael Bay and Benedict Cumberbatch to Be Interviewed
content_en:
Diane Morgan is set to return as the hilariously clueless Philomena Cunk in *Cunk on Cinema*, a new three-part mockumentary exploring the history of film. A first-look image has been released alongside an impressive lineup of guest interviewees.

Hollywood heavyweights Michael Bay and Benedict Cumberbatch are among those set to face Cunk's signature bizarre questioning. The guest list also includes *Die Hard* screenwriter Steven E. de Souza, cinematographer Seamus McGarvey, composer Daniel Pemberton, film critic Mark Kermode, and documentary filmmaker Mark Cousins.

Following the success of *Cunk on Earth*, the new series will trace the evolution of cinema—from the invention of the camera and the 1960s New Wave to the modern-day impacts of CGI and artificial intelligence. The show is spearheaded by lead writer Charlie Brooker, with Al Campbell directing and Diane Morgan also contributing to the script.

*Cunk on Cinema* will air on BBC Two and BBC iPlayer in the UK, and will be available on Netflix for international audiences outside of the UK and Ireland.
